name: Matterhorn Wholesale
description: Matterhorn Wholesale B2B dropshipping API for fashion catalog discovery, product variants and stock, delivery methods, and order creation and tracking.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Generate the API key after logging in to the Matterhorn Wholesale customer panel.

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List Matterhorn product categories with their IDs, names, and category paths. Use category IDs to filter products and inventory.

tools.name: brands_list
tools.description: List Matterhorn brands with their IDs and names. Use brand IDs to filter products and inventory.

tools.name: currencies_list
tools.description: List currencies available to the authenticated Matterhorn account.

tools.name: delivery_methods_list
tools.description: List Matterhorn delivery methods across countries, including delivery method ID, price, minimum order value, carrier, and estimated delivery days.

tools.name: delivery_methods_by_country
tools.description: List Matterhorn delivery methods available for a destination country. Use the returned ID as delivery_method_id when creating an order.

country_code.description: Two-letter destination country code, for example DE, ES, FR, or US.

tools.name: products_list
tools.description: List full Matterhorn product records, including descriptions, images, prices, variants, and stock. Supports incremental synchronization with last_update.

new_collection.description: Set to 1 to return products added within the last 60 days.

last_update.description: Return products whose price or stock changed since this timestamp, formatted YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

limit.description: Products per page; Matterhorn allows up to 1000.

tools.name: inventory_list
tools.description: List lightweight Matterhorn prices and inventory levels without full descriptions and images. Supports incremental synchronization with last_update.

new_collection.description: Set to 1 to return products added within the last 60 days.

last_update.description: Return products whose price or stock changed since this timestamp, formatted YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

limit.description: Products per page; Matterhorn allows up to 1000.

tools.name: product_get
tools.description: Get one Matterhorn product by ID with images, prices, variants, and current stock.

tools.name: product_get_by_ean
tools.description: Get a Matterhorn product using the EAN of one of its variants.

ean.description: EAN belonging to a Matterhorn product variant.

tools.name: orders_list
tools.description: List orders belonging to the authenticated Matterhorn account.

tools.name: order_get
tools.description: Get a Matterhorn order by ID, including status, completion rate, totals, delivery address, positions, invoice, payment, and tracking information.

tools.name: order_create
tools.description: Create a Matterhorn order. This endpoint intentionally uses PUT. Orders cannot be paid through the API; use the returned payment_url or the customer panel.

items.description: Matterhorn variants and quantities to order.

variant_uid.description: Matterhorn variant UID or variant EAN.

delivery_to.description: Optional dropshipping destination. Omit it to use the account address.

delivery_method_id.description: Delivery method ID returned by delivery_methods_by_country. If omitted, Matterhorn chooses the cheapest available method.
